rachel_csm: Heads-up: NovusQuill renewal in ~6 weeks. They're happy feature-wise but flagged rising inference costs and occasional p95 spikes at peak. Suggest a 48h canary: 10% traffic -> m-quill-v1:int8 + route non-critical batch/embeddings to m-small-lite. Need eng + SRE OK and customer signoff.

diego_cs: They'll ask for concrete savings % and rollback SLA. Please include numbers we can put in Gainsight.

rachel_csm: Baseline (last 72h): p50 155ms, p95 460ms, tails to 1.1s when concurrency >70. Unit cost ~ $402 / 1M tokens. Estimated int8 compute savings ~32-36%. Median latency may +10-25ms but throughput rise should cut queueing; tail could improve.

izzy_engineer: I can build m-quill-v1:int8 and run regression on their 180-sample eval. Recommend 48h @10% with automated similarity/error checks and manual spot review. Regression thresholds: pass_rate >= 0.9, max_metric_delta <= 0.02.

omar_sre: Infra: bump min replicas for canary pool to avoid autoscale gaps; enable per-route prefix caching for repeated contexts. Also add routing rule: send embeddings and bulk indexing to m-small-lite. Alert: p95 > 750ms OR error_rate > 0.5% -> rollback.

izzy_engineer: Deploy snippet: ```bash
redwoodctl deploy --customer novusquill --model m-quill-v1:int8 --route canary --weight 0.10 --tag nq-canary-0326
```

deploy-bot: Canary started for novusquill (canary id: nq-canary-a7). Weight: 10%. Region: us-west-2.

rachel_csm: Draft customer message: "We propose a 48-hour, 10% canary using a quantized model to evaluate unit cost savings (~32-36%). We'll monitor automated metrics and manual samples and will roll back within 30 minutes if thresholds breach." Thoughts?

diego_cs: Good. Add explicit rollback SLA and note we'll share sample diffs. I'll add the plan to Gainsight.

izzy_engineer: Local eval on 180 samples: pass 165/180, avg_similarity 0.981, max_delta 0.014. Small formatting diffs on tables. Will attach diffs to ticket NQ-5021.

omar_sre: Autoscale min set to 3 for canary pool; routing rules and alerts configured. Monitoring dashboards live.

rachel_csm: Action items: izzy -> full regression + attach diffs (ETA 6h). omar -> confirm alerts/monitoring (ETA 1h). diego -> Gainsight + customer outreach (ETA 3h). Reconvene 24h after rollout. Thanks everyone :rocket:
